import pathlib
base=pathlib.Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out-3/play/users/u042/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Uniform full rows and columns are the separators.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != 0]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != 0]
    sep_color = grid[sep_rows[0]][0]
    row_starts = [0] + [r + 1 for r in sep_rows]
    row_ends = sep_rows + [h]
    col_starts = [0] + [c + 1 for c in sep_cols]
    col_ends = sep_cols + [w]
    # Each row of panels is keyed by the colored marker in its first panel.
    colors = []
    for rs, re in zip(row_starts, row_ends):
        vals = {grid[r][c] for r in range(rs, re) for c in range(col_starts[0], col_ends[0]) if grid[r][c] not in (0, sep_color)}
        colors.append(next(iter(vals)))
    # Find the nonempty panel outside the marker column and use its occupied cells as a mask.
    candidates = []
    for ri, (rs, re) in enumerate(zip(row_starts, row_ends)):
        for ci, (cs, ce) in enumerate(zip(col_starts, col_ends)):
            if ci == 0: continue
            cells = [(r-rs, c-cs) for r in range(rs, re) for c in range(cs, ce) if grid[r][c] not in (0, sep_color)]
            if cells: candidates.append((len(cells), cells))
    mask = max(candidates, key=lambda x: x[0])[1]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri, (rs, re) in enumerate(zip(row_starts, row_ends)):
        for ci, (cs, ce) in enumerate(zip(col_starts, col_ends)):
            for r in range(rs, re):
                for c in range(cs, ce): out[r][c] = 0
            for dr, dc in mask: out[rs+dr][cs+dc] = colors[ri]
    return out
'''
